name: AGL Telco
summary: AGL Energy's retail telco arm (NBN broadband from Nov 2020 + AGL Mobile from Feb 2021; built on Southern Phone, acq. Dec 2019); sold to Aussie Broadband for $115M in shares (Feb 2026), making ABB Australia's third-largest NBN provider (AGL ENERGY LIMITED, ACN 115 061 375).

events.details: AGL launched NBN broadband under the AGL brand 13 Nov 2020 (AGL Mobile followed Feb 2021), building on Southern Phone Company (regional telco, ~168,000 services; acquired 19 Dec 2019).
AGL agreed to sell its telecommunications business to Aussie Broadband for $115M in ABB shares (plus up to $10M on growth targets), Feb 2026, making Aussie the third-largest NBN provider.
